message.content:
The storage stores doc IDs as strings; my preview compared ints to string keys. Fixing preview to convert keys.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'EOF'
import re
src = open('tinydb/journal.py').read()
old = """        table = self._db.table(self._table_name)

        # Work on a deep copy of the current table data so that the real
        # table (and its query cache) is never touched.
        data = self._db.storage.read()
        sim = copy.deepcopy(data.get(self._table_name, {})) if data else {}
"""
new = """        table = self._db.table(self._table_name)

        # Work on a deep copy of the current table data so that the real
        # table (and its query cache) is never touched. Storage may keep
        # document IDs as strings, so convert them back to the table's
        # document ID class first.
        data = self._db.storage.read()
        raw = data.get(self._table_name, {}) if data else {}
        sim = {
            table.document_id_class(doc_id): copy.deepcopy(doc)
            for doc_id, doc in raw.items()
        }
"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('tinydb/journal.py','w').write(src)
print('patched')
EOF
python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('/testbed/tinydb/journal.py').read()); print('syntax ok')""}
